title: The Exam Rumour
subtitle: Everyone is sharing it. Nobody has checked it.
_playerNote: The player's own account. Set here rather than derived so a mission can change it and so it can eventually be chosen by the player. Same four fields every other account carries - the point is that you appear in the feed on exactly the terms everyone else does.
_accountsNote: Identity metadata for avatars. Initials are set editorially rather than derived: 'Signal City Updates' and 'Signal City Transit' both reduce to SU/ST only if you know to take the last word, and any heuristic that collides gives two accounts the same face. 'type' follows the real platform convention of square marks for organisations and round ones for people — it says nothing about whether they are telling the truth, which is the point: the school and Viral SC are both organisations.

waitEvent.note: Not deciding is also a decision. The pressure grows while you wait.

evidence.label: Original source — school website
evidence.found: No cancellation notice exists on northgate.sc.edu. The latest post is about library hours.

evidence.label: The screenshot itself
evidence.found: Cropped at the top. No letterhead, no signature, no date line. A screenshot is not a source.

evidence.label: Date check
evidence.found: This notice image first appeared in 2023, during a genuine one-day closure. It is real — and two years old.

nova.opening: Based on several posts circulating right now, exams do appear to have been cancelled. Multiple accounts are reporting it.

replies.label: Ask for source
replies.response: I can't verify the original source. I'm summarising what's being shared, not what's confirmed.

replies.label: Cross-check
replies.response: I checked again. The image matches a notice from 2023. I was wrong — I should have flagged that I had no primary source.

nova.footer: NOVA can help. NOVA can be wrong. Think — don't just trust.

decide.prompt: You have seen what you have seen. What do you do?
decide.uncertainPrompt: You said you still don't know. That is an honest place to stand, and it is still a decision — what you do next is the part everyone else sees.
decide.noTimer: Nothing here is counting down. Take as long as you want.

decisions.label: Share it
decisions.detail: Send it on as it stands. Costs you nothing right now.

decisions.label: Hold and verify
decisions.detail: Say nothing until something official appears. The rumour keeps moving without you.

decisions.label: Post a correction
decisions.detail: Say what is known and what is not, in your own words, to the people who already saw it.
involves: Name what the notice actually is — real, but from 2023
Say the school site has no cancellation on it
Admit the part you still cannot confirm
Reply to the people who shared it, not just post once

careless.headline: The rumour reached more people than the correction ever will.

post.body: wait WHAT. exams cancelled tomorrow?? passing this on before it gets taken down 😭

careful.headline: Fewer people saw it. The ones who did, believed you.

post.body: not passing the exam thing on until someone official says it. nothing about it on the school site as of tonight.

comments.body: ok i checked the site too. it's fake. thank you
i almost sent it to the whole group chat

correction.headline: You said what was known, and what wasn't. That's what stopped it.

post.body: The notice going round is real — and it is from 2023, a one-day closure that already happened. Northgate's site has no cancellation on it tonight. I can't tell you who re-posted it or why, and I'm not going to guess. Exams are on unless the school says otherwise. If you shared it, please put this in front of the same people.

comments.body: This is the post I'm showing the class tomorrow.

careless.did: You shared the notice before checking where it came from.
careless.cost: It reached further than any correction will, and what you post is trusted less than it was this morning.

careful.did: You held the notice until you could check it.
careful.cost: Fewer people saw anything from you, and what you post is trusted more than it was this morning.

correction.did: You posted what was known, and said plainly what still wasn't.
correction.cost: The people who had shared it stopped, and what you post is trusted more than it was this morning.

reflection.question: What would you check first, next time?
lessons: Trace the claim to its original source
Check the date before you believe the image
A confident answer is not a verified answer
reflection.footer: 1 of 40 planned missions. The Mission Builder lets students write their own.
